facts.fact: Lorraine 说 Kit 大约三天没好好吃饭，本以为他能吃下一个三明治。
facts.anchor: “He’s not eaten properly for about three days,” she says. “I thought he might manage a sandwich.”

facts.fact: Soren 回答 Lorraine：留下 Kit 是为了不让他被坏人利用、折磨或操纵。
facts.anchor: “So he doesn’t end up being used, or tortured, or manipulated by… very bad people.”

facts.fact: Lorraine 像在解剖另一个版本的 Soren，直呼其全名 Soren Sinclair 问他为什么在意。
facts.anchor: Like she’s dissecting a version of me that isn’t actually there. “And why do you, Soren Sinclair… care?”

facts.fact: Soren 说新招募的 Aria 先由 Selina 观察几个月，Luke 做背景调查。
facts.anchor: “I’ve got Selina keeping an eye on her for the next few months before I decide. Luke’s doing all the background checks.

facts.fact: 叙述称 Ray 是 Soren 这辈子最接近真朋友的人，可靠。
facts.anchor: Ray’s the closest thing I have to a real friend in this life… solid, reliable

facts.fact: Soren 一言不发地从女人体内抽出，系好裤子和腰带。
facts.anchor: I pull out of the woman without a word, already reaching down… belt fastened and trousers done up.

facts.fact: Kit 手里的玻璃杯滑落，在地上摔碎，他当场慌了。
facts.anchor: The glass slips from his fingers and shatters against the floor; he panics instantly.

facts.fact: Soren 抓住 Kit 的手，用力把创可贴按在伤口上。
facts.anchor: Catching his small hand, I yank it up and press the band-aid over the cut with more force than necessary
